intro: From the Urdu Wikipedia article on Sir Syed Ahmad Khan, the 19th-century reformer whose college at Aligarh became Aligarh Muslim University: the first paragraph of the section on his family and early education. The name of his brother's journal looks garbled in the source; it was probably “Sayyid-ul-Akhbar”.

sentences.urdu: سرسید احمد خان 17 اکتوبر 1817ء کو دہلی میں پیدا ہوئے۔
sentences.english: Sir Syed Ahmad Khan was born in Delhi on 17 October 1817.

sentences.urdu: آبا و اجداد ترک برلاس قبیلے سے تھے۔
sentences.english: His forefathers were from the Turkic Barlas tribe.

sentences.urdu: شاہ جہاں کے عہد میں ہرات سے ہندوستان آئے۔
sentences.english: They came to India from Herat in the reign of Shah Jahan.

sentences.urdu: سر سید احمد خان نے دستور زمانہ کے مطابق عربی اور فارسی کی تعلیم حاصل کی۔
sentences.english: Following the custom of the times, Sir Syed Ahmad Khan was educated in Arabic and Persian.

sentences.urdu: آپ نے ابتدائی تعلیم اپنے نانا خواجہ فرید الدین احمد خان سے حاصل کی۔
sentences.english: He received his early education from his maternal grandfather, Khwaja Fariduddin Ahmad Khan.

sentences.urdu: ابتدائی تعلیم میں آپ نے قرآن پاک کا مطالعہ کیا اور عربی اور فارسی ادب کا مطالعہ بھی کیا۔
sentences.english: In his early education he studied the Holy Quran, and he also studied Arabic and Persian literature.

sentences.urdu: اس کے علاوہ آپ نے حساب، طب اور تاریخ میں بھی مہارت حاصل کی۔
sentences.english: Besides this, he also gained skill in mathematics, medicine and history.

sentences.urdu: سر سید نے کئی سال ادویات کا مطالعہ بھی کیا۔
sentences.english: Sir Syed also studied medicines for several years.

sentences.urdu: ان کے بڑے بھائی نے شہر میں سب سے پہلے پرنٹنگ پریس کی بنیاد رکھی، جہاں سے جریدہ القران اکبر شائع ہوتا تھا۔
sentences.english: His elder brother set up the very first printing press in the city, from which the journal “Al-Quran Akbar” was published.

سر: Sir (the British title, in “sar sayyid”); usually “head”
شاہ: king; Shah (“shaah jahaan” = Shah Jahan, the Mughal emperor)
جہاں: where (“jahaan se” = from where); world (“shaah jahaan” = Shah Jahan, “king of the world”)
دستور: custom; practice (“dastoor-e-zamaana” = the custom of the times)
تعلیم: education (“taaleem haasil karna” = to be educated)
مہارت: skill; expertise (“mahaarat haasil karna” = to master)
پہلے: first (“sab se pehle” = the very first)
بنیاد: foundation (“buniyaad rakhna” = to found, set up)
القران: Al-Quran (part of the journal's name as written here)
اکبر: “great” (part of the journal's name as written here)
شائع: published (“shaaya hota tha” = used to be published)

questions.urdu: سر سید کب اور کہاں پیدا ہوئے؟
questions.english: When and where was Sir Syed born?

questions.urdu: سر سید نے ابتدائی تعلیم کس سے حاصل کی؟
questions.english: From whom did Sir Syed receive his early education?

options.urdu: اپنے نانا خواجہ فرید الدین احمد خان سے
options.english: From his maternal grandfather, Khwaja Fariduddin Ahmad Khan

questions.urdu: سر سید کے بڑے بھائی نے شہر میں کیا کام سب سے پہلے کیا؟
questions.english: What was Sir Syed's elder brother the first to do in the city?

options.english: He set up a printing press
